# iRoofer Contractors

> Licensed, bonded and insured family-owned roofing contractor in Dallas, Georgia, providing roof repair, replacement, new-construction roofing, storm and hail damage restoration with insurance-claim support, and gutter work across the west Atlanta metro.

iRoofer Contractors is a local, family-owned roofing company based in Dallas, Georgia (Paulding County), serving the west Atlanta metro since 2019. It handles roof repair, full roof replacement, new-construction roofing, storm and hail damage restoration, insurance-claim support, and gutter repair/replacement. The company is licensed, bonded, and insured, holds a 5.0 rating across ~54 Google reviews, and offers free inspections with no-pressure written quotes.

## Services
- [Roof Repair](https://iroofercontractors.com/services/roof-repair/): leak and storm-damage fixes, flashing, vent, and shingle repair across the Atlanta metro.
- [Roof Replacement](https://iroofercontractors.com/services/roof-replacement/): full tear-off and re-roof with architectural asphalt shingles installed by an Owens Corning Preferred Contractor, manufacturer warranty plus a written workmanship guarantee.
- [New Construction](https://iroofercontractors.com/services/new-construction/): roof installation for builders and homeowners on new builds.
- [Storm & Hail Damage](https://iroofercontractors.com/services/storm-damage-roof-repair/): free inspections, same-day emergency tarping, insurance documentation, and adjuster meetings.
- [Gutter Repair & Replacement](https://iroofercontractors.com/services/gutter-repair-replacement/): repair, realignment, and replacement of gutters and downspouts.
